introduction: Ten pieces of the wiring between your ears.

entries.clue: One of some 86 billion in a human head
entries.sourceNotes: Azevedo et al. (2009) estimated roughly 86 billion neurons in the adult human brain.

entries.clue: Support staff of the nervous system
entries.explanation: Non-signalling cells that insulate, feed and clean up after the signalling ones.

factCards.text: A 2009 cell count estimated about 86 billion neurons in the adult human brain, with a roughly equal number of non-neuronal cells.
factCards.sourceTitle: Azevedo et al., Journal of Comparative Neurology (2009)

factCards.text: Myelin is made by glial cells: oligodendrocytes wrap axons in the brain and spinal cord, Schwann cells do the job in the rest of the body.
factCards.sourceTitle: Kandel et al., Principles of Neural Science

factCards.text: The amygdala takes its name from the Greek word for almond, a description of its shape rather than its job.
